For these mappings, publisher identity, title, description/chapter scope, video ID and direct URLs were checked on 20 November 2026. Independent supplements are labelled separately from original Official ICT uploads. YouTube embedding permission was not checked; the regular YouTube fallback link is retained. TTrades' descriptions contain promotional/affiliate links, which do not constitute an endorsement by this project.

The MMBM upload is an example, not a complete MMBM rulebook, an independently verified definition, or evidence of strategy performance. The Academy's MMBM definition remains supplemental and convention-sensitive, and the page continues to disclose that no audited performance evidence is available.

## Coverage and remaining work

The strict generated registry now reports **51/82 lesson pages** and **4/8 Entry Models** with a verified exact-item video. The eight model pages are included within the 82 Academy pages and remain separately tracked for acceptance. The remaining 31 lesson pages and four Entry Model pages still need individually verified mappings. A channel page, search result, or adjacent topic is not counted as item coverage.

The mapping does not complete Part 2. Review direct-link availability and embed permission separately, keep the source and coverage current, and complete the full Academy's visual, mobile, keyboard and assistive-technology QA.
